method: Whole-file manual source review of four files, bytes compared to pinned Git objects. No Windows watcher runtime executed.
findings: StartMonitoring stops prior threads, creates one jthread per selected root, and uses recursive ReadDirectoryChangesW with64KiB buffer. Stop requests all stop tokens then clears/join threads; cancellation path calls CancelIoEx and waits GetOverlappedResult before freeing request storage. Actual Windows cancellation not tested.

IsMonitoring only checks nonempty thread vector. A WatchDirectory early return for failed open/event creation leaves its thread object in vector until StopMonitoring; reported monitoring state is not proof of successful directory subscription.

Zero-byte completion is silently continued; non-aborted GetOverlappedResult errors also continue. No explicit completeness/lost-event marker or reconciliation scan in this control. This source path does not provide lossless incremental-index evidence.

Rename old/new actions are recorded as separate action/path entries; no rename pairing identity maintained. Entry timestamp is event-processing system time, not file last-write time. Metadata query failure leaves zero-initialized size/attributes, relevant to deleted or renamed-old paths.

Pending queue is drained at most1024events per UI callback. All drained records move to history even when hidden by filter. No history/pending count or byte budget visible in this module; batching bounds callback count, not retained memory.

Quick-filter compilation and matching collect candidate visible items before committing new filter/view. Regex errors return false and preserve prior state; clearing filter restores retained history. No model rescan is performed by this filter.

Notification coalescing uses atomic changePending and reposts if queue nonempty after drain. PostMessage failure clears flag but queued events await a later post trigger; no retry timer visible. No scheduling/liveness runtime claim.
ClearResults drains pending and clears history without stopping producers; events arriving concurrently may appear after clear. This is a history action, not a quiescent filesystem snapshot.

Progress dialog task runs on jthread; IsCancelled reads explicit atomic flag, not jthread stop token. Cancel sets flag, disables button, joins via RunTaskWithUiUpdates, then closes. ShowModal also joins surviving worker. Cancellation latency depends on task cooperation.
Progress task lambda has no local exception handler; propagation out of task into thread would terminate under standard C++ semantics unless task itself catches. No throw injection executed.

Worker performs synchronous final WM_TIMER send then posts IDOK unless cancelled. UI pumping during cancellation is therefore relevant to join ordering; helper RunTaskWithUiUpdates not yet whole-file qualified. No deadlock runtime claim.
limits: No Windows directory notifications, overflow, remote-share, rename, shutdown or UI runtime controls.
No current defect impact inferred beyond source-observed conditions.
No production code adopted; native pHash investigation remains deferred.
